propositions: A single Gerrit Verified run requires 21 concurrent job slots but navapbc org on GitHub Free is limited to 20 total concurrent jobs shared across all repos, causing later runs to queue 6.7–8.4 minutes for macOS slots and extending total run time from ~21m to 41–47m.

The current _optionality.yml fans out 6 matrix cells (5 per-extra plus union) that each hold a slot for checkout + setup-python + install while doing only 0.4–0.8m of real work, wasting concurrency capacity.

The per-extra matrix list and _optional.EXTRAS are not identical: mcp is in the matrix but not in _optional.EXTRAS and has no detection probe, while metrics is in _optional.EXTRAS but has no per-extra CI job today.

Collapsing per-extra and union jobs into a single venv-loop job reduces peak concurrent slots from 6 to 1 while maintaining isolation (separate venv per extra) and preserving the union iteration that exercises joint dependency resolution.
Each venv iteration must use absolute paths ("$v/bin/python", "$v/bin/rebar-mcp") and never activate across iterations to prevent silent test failures from PATH reuse or interpreter shadowing.
The loop must accumulate failures with an rc accumulator and use continue/exit $rc to ensure all iterations run independently and the whole step fails if any iteration fails, preserving diagnostics.
